fusions.name: Trample Run
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles forward and trample, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Iron-Shod Shove
fusions.desc: Kicks the target with a hind-leg of scales, dealing 40 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Cantering Guard
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 30% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Pace
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times. Once every 8 seconds.
